احتفرتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَرْتُنَّ (iḥtafartunna) /iħ.ta.far.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اُحْتُفِرْتُنَّ (uḥtufirtunna) /uħ.tu.fir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
